blocks.title: Overview
blocks.text: Through subsidiaries, SK hynix researches, develops, manufactures, distributes, and sells semiconductor devices. The supplied company overview describes operations across Korea, China, the rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally.

evidence.quote: through its subsidiaries, engages in research, develops, manufactures, distributes, and sells semiconductor devices

cells: DRAM (server, graphics, mobile, PC, consumer); NAND flash; SSD; MCP

evidence.quote: It offers DRAM, such as server memory, graphics memory, mobile memory, PC memory, consumer memory; NAND flash memory; SSD; and MCP products.
It also engages in foundry business, produces non-memory semiconductors.

cells: Server, networking, mobile, personal computer, consumer, and automotive

evidence.quote: The company serves its products for server, networking, mobile, personal computer, consumer, and automotive applications.

blocks.title: Reported demand signal
blocks.text: Yahoo Scout describes strong demand from AI data centers as a growth driver. This is a third-party market comment, not a statement in the supplied 6-K.

evidence.quote: SK Hynix is experiencing strong demand from AI data centers, driving growth and expansion plans.
